export.title: Export
export.description: Before reinstalling this server, download all Claude conversations as one file.
export.encryptDescription: The file contains your full chat history. A protected file can only be imported here, with the password; a forgotten password cannot be recovered.
export.started: Downloading {{fileName}}. A large history can take a while.
export.passwordTooShort_one: The password needs at least {{count}} character.
export.passwordTooShort_other: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.
export.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
export.includes: Included: Claude transcripts, project memory, code checkpoints, task lists, images attached to chats, and chat titles, archive, drafts, scheduled messages and preferences.
export.excludes: Not included: the Claude sign-in, ClaudeWeb accounts and keys, plugins, and project folders unless you choose them below.
export.projectFilesDescription: Adds the chosen folders as they are now, with their Git history. Large folders make a large backup; existing files are never replaced on import.
export.projectFilesNone: No project folders in the home folder.

import.title: Import
import.description: After a reinstall and sign-in, drop the exported file here. Conversations that already exist are skipped, never overwritten.
import.drop: Drop the backup file here, or click to choose it
import.keepOpen: Keep this page open until the upload has finished.
import.passwordTitle: This backup is protected with a password
import.relocated: Made on a server whose home folder is {{from}}. Paths under it are restored under {{to}}, so the conversations continue there.
import.pathMissing: This folder does not exist on this server. The conversations can be read after the import, but to continue them, create the folder (or get the code back) first.
import.pathUnknown: The original folder of these files is not recorded in the backup.
import.space: Adds about {{required}}; {{free}} free on this server.
import.importingHint: This continues on the server even if you close this page.
import.skipped_one: Skipped {{count}} conversation that was already here.
import.skipped_other: Skipped {{count}} conversations that were already here.
import.doneHint: They are in the sidebar now, and can also be continued in a terminal with claude --resume.

archive.title: Archived sessions
archive.description: Archived sessions and projects are not shown in the sidebar. Restore one to bring it back, or delete it for good.

archive.deleteFailed: Could not delete it. Try again.
archive.deleteConfirm: Delete "{{title}}" for good? Its conversation history is removed and cannot be restored.
archive.deleteProjectConfirm: Permanently delete the project "{{title}}"? All of its conversations will be deleted and cannot be recovered. The project folder and its files are not touched.

promptSuggestions.label: Next-prompt suggestions
promptSuggestions.description: Show a faint suggestion after a reply. Tab or Right arrow accepts it; sending still requires confirmation. Generating suggestions uses additional tokens.

yourClaude.nameDescription: Saved in your Claude CLAUDE.md ({{path}}), so every chat, the web terminal and SSH sessions use it from the next message.
yourClaude.autoMemoryDescription: Claude saves useful details from your sessions and reads them back in later ones.
yourClaude.directoryDescription: Leave empty for the default: ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/. Use an absolute path or one starting with ~/.
yourClaude.autoDreamDescription: Merges and cleans up saved memory while you are away. Uses some of your plan usage.
yourClaude.autoDreamDefault: Not set: Claude decides by default.
yourClaude.settingsInvalid: {{path}} is not valid JSON, so the memory switches are read-only. Fix or remove the file first.
yourClaude.footnote: Memory switches are stored in {{path}}, the same file the CLI’s /memory screen uses. Changes apply from the next message.
yourClaude.outputStyleNote: How Claude structures its responses in every chat, saved as outputStyle in Claude’s settings.json (the same setting as the CLI’s /output-style). Your own styles go in output-styles/ in the Claude folder. Applies from the next message.
yourClaude.styleMissing: This style is not in the list; the CLI may not find it.
